scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap open ios
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:build:ios: npm run mobile:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath .mobile-build/ios CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.mobile:build:android: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug
scripts.mobile:bundle:android: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon bundleRelease
